description: This file defines the class AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration, a subclass of CommandEndpointConfiguration, used for configuring test scenarios related to AMQP command endpoints, including properties such as subscriber role and endpoint versioning, along with methods for string representation and generating subscription addresses based on tenant and device IDs.

classes.name: AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration properties for defining variants of Command & Control related test scenarios for AMQP protocol, with methods for constructing subscription addresses and string representation of configuration state.

methods.name: AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the configuration with subscriber role and endpoint version flags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration, including subscriber role and endpoint information.

methods.name: getSubscriptionAddress
methods.description: Generates and returns the subscription address for a device or gateway based on tenant ID and device ID, taking into account whether the configuration subscribes as a gateway for a single device.
